title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de CI/CD robustas e escaláveis, com foco em GitLab e ArgoCD .
  • Definir padrões e melhores práticas para Dockerfiles e gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Administrar e otimizar clusters OKE (Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes) em produção.
  • Liderar a automação de infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform .
  • Implementar estratégias completas de observabilidade , com Grafana, Dynatrace e Datadog .
  • Integrar ferramentas de segurança e qualidade de código, como Sonarqube e Veracode , ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir testes de performance com K6 e definir métricas de sucesso.
  • Liderar a implantação de soluções de autoscaling (Keda) e otimizações (Redwolf).
  • Mentorar a equipe, disseminando as melhores práticas de DevOps e SRE .

title: Agriculture Specialist
description:
We are looking for Image Annotation Analyst having background in Agriculture from Brazil. If you are interested and reside in Brazil, kindly apply to the post on urgent basis as we are anticipating the project to get started this week.


Please find the details below: -

  • Project Name: Image Annotation Analyst- Agriculture
  • Hourly Rate: $16 per hour
  • Required Hours: 5-6 hours per day (flexible hours)
  • Project Start Date: This week
  • Location: Brazil
  • Language: local
  • Required Education: Agriculture or agriculture related streams like horticulture , food science etc.


We are looking for an Annotation Analyst to join the team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for annotating agriculture dataset, identifying crop type and stages, ensuring the quality, consistency, and accuracy of datasets. Raters are required to interpretate crop types, annotation, and identifying the stages.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/master’s degree in agriculture
  • Experience in agricultural field studies and data annotation.
  • Knowledge of crop classification, phenology (growth stages), and field boundary identification.
  • Prior work with street view imagery of agricultural datasets.

title: Ilustrador(a) / Artista Digital Freelancer até Dezembro – Início Imediato / Digital Artist Until December – Immediate Start
description:
Ilustrador Freelance – Início Imediato


Envie sua inscrição aqui:


A Scopio está contratando ilustradores e artistas digitais para entregar arquivos PSD editáveis e em camadas para um projeto global de tecnologia.

Este é um contrato remoto temporário que vai até dezembro. Os artistas devem atender a requisitos rigorosos para PSDs em camadas e deverão entregar de 10 a 20 arquivos até 7 de outubro de 2025 como parte do processo de integração.


Responsabilidades

  • Produzir ilustrações em PSD de alta qualidade, editáveis e em camadas (não são aceitos JPEGs nem exportações achatadas).
  • Entregar arquivos que atendam às especificações técnicas:
  • Tamanho mínimo: 2000×2000 px, 150 DPI, RGB.
  • Camadas organizadas com nomes claros em inglês (ex.: Character_1, Background_Sky).
  • Não serão aceitos PSDs achatados/rasterizados nem obras geradas por IA.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente e cumprir prazos curtos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada na criação de ilustrações em PSD com camadas (portfólio obrigatório).
  • Capacidade de entregar 10–20 arquivos PSD até 7 de outubro de 2025 como lote de teste.
  • Forte habilidade em ilustração, incluindo personagens, cenários, objetos e cenas abstratas/editoriais.
  • Domínio em Photoshop, Illustrator (com exportação para PSD) ou Procreate (com exportação para PSD).
  • Compromisso com altos padrões de qualidade e organização de arquivos (guia fornecido).
  • Não serão aceitos: imagens geradas por IA, PSDs achatados, ícones, logotipos ou arquivos sem camadas editáveis.

Freelance Illustrator – Immediate Start


Scopio is hiring illustrators and digital artists to deliver layered, editable PSD files for a global technology project.

This is a temporary remote contract that will run until December. Artists must meet strict requirements for layered PSDs and will be expected to deliver 10–20 files by October 7 as part of the onboarding process.

Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality layered, editable PSD illustrations (not JPEGs or flat exports).
  • Deliver files that meet technical specifications:
  • Minimum size: 2000×2000 px, 150 DPI, RGB color.
  • Organized layers with clear English names (e.g., Character_1, Background_Sky).
  • No flattened/rasterized PSDs and no AI-generated artwork.
  • Work independently and meet tight deadlines.


Requirements

  • Proven experience creating layered PSD illustrations (portfolio required).
  • Ability to deliver 10–20 PSD files by October 7, 2025, as a test batch.
  • Strong illustration skills, including characters, environments, objects, and abstract/editorial scenes.
  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator (with PSD export), or Procreate (with PSD export).
  • Commitment to strict quality and file organization standards (guide provided).
  • Not accepted: AI-generated images, flat PSDs, icons, logos, or files without editable layers.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of DevOps and AWS experience to work with other team members on maintaining and executing organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management of the client's solutions for internal and customer environments.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2,000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, which reduces operating costs, saves time, and increases profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their infrastructure requirements, design solutions with cost mitigation in mind that meet their needs, and implement transparently and efficiently
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices via tools such as Terraform
  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines - ensure rapid yet reliable code deployments
  • Integrate security practices into the infrastructure development lifecycle, including network security, identity management, and data protection
  • Ensure the achievement of SLOs via the implementation of effective SLIs to monitor systems and aid in issue diagnosis
  • Expand documentation and provide training to ensure clarity and proficient management by others, reducing future onboarding time
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing and DevOps trends and best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 6+ years of experience in architecting, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-grade software solutions using AWS across various delivery modalities - mobile applications, web applications, APIs, web services, and UI frameworks
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipeline optimization via IaC platforms, must be highly knowledgeable of Terraform
  • Solid experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), version control systems (Git), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, and more)
  • Proven site reliability experience achieving SLOs through the definition and implementation of effective SLIs
  • Experience with operational database management in AWS (Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL)
  • Deep understanding of modern security best practices and a proven track record of implementing secure solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A strong aptitude for tackling complex challenges with right-size solutions that mitigate costs while assuring exceptional end-user experiences
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in environments that are constantly evolving and occasionally ambiguous


Desired Experience (not required)

  • University degree in Business, MIS, or Engineering
  • Familiar with New Relic, Loggly, and CloudWatch
  • Skilled in shell scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, and PowerShell)


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment, while building software. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Project Manager
description:
If you are passionate about leading projects end-to-end, aligning teams, and ensuring clients achieve real results, this role is for you. At SMT, our Project Managers are strategic partners who shape outcomes and help clients unlock the full value of the Medallia platform.

What You Will Do

  • Lead implementation projects from discovery and design to testing, training, and go-live.
  • Act as the main point of contact with clients — building trust, managing expectations, and ensuring flawless delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (analysts, consultants, solution architects, developers, and client stakeholders) to meet milestones and deliverables on time.
  • Define project plans, schedules, and scope while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder engagement at every stage.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize delivery, enhance processes, and maximize client value.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Support and coach project team members, ensuring alignment with goals and high-quality results.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a Project Manager, preferably in SaaS or technology-driven environments.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong business acumen in project planning and management.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills to manage complex projects effectively.
  • Exceptional communication skills — equally comfortable with executives and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with a focus on quality and client success.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and French


✨ Join us and help transform how organizations understand and act on customer experience.

Valorizamos quem contribui para um ambiente de loja vibrante, acolhedor e cheio de energia positiva onde o trabalho em equipe e o cuidado com cada detalhe fazem toda a diferença.

Venha construir momentos inesquecíveis conosco!


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial – Lindt Boulevard shopping Belém (Belém - PA)


VENDEDOR

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento direto ao cliente, garantindo uma experiência de compra positiva por meio da apresentação, degustação e recomendação de produtos.
  • Atuar com foco no atingimento das metas comerciais, contribuindo de forma ativa para os resultados da loja.
  • Executar as atividades de venda, promovendo os produtos da companhia de forma consultiva, clara e eficiente.
  • Manter a organização, limpeza e conservação do ambiente de loja, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões globais de apresentação e atendimento.
  • Cumprir prazos e realizar tarefas operacionais com qualidade e atenção aos detalhes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e apaixonado por chocolates.


SUBGERENTE (VENDEDOR MASTER)

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a gestão e o desenvolvimento da equipe, contribuindo para o bom desempenho do time e assegurando a continuidade das ações gerenciais da loja, com foco no alcance das metas comerciais.
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos resultados, acompanhando indicadores, propondo estratégias e identificando oportunidades que contribuam para o atingimento dos objetivos definidos pela companhia.
  • Atuar nos controles operacionais da loja, garantindo a execução dos processos diários. relacionados a vendas, estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho organizado e eficiente.
  • Apoiar, sempre que necessário, a administração geral da loja, colaborando com a condução das atividades da equipe, o desempenho comercial e o atendimento às demandas da matriz.
  • Participar das trocas de turno, garantindo o repasse claro e preciso de informações, destacando ocorrências relevantes, pendências e atividades concluídas, com o objetivo de manter a comunicação alinhada entre as equipes.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao cliente e vendas.
  • Vivência em liderança de equipe ou apoio à gestão será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil comunicativo, proativo e com forte senso de responsabilidade.
  • Paixão por encantar clientes e apaixonado por chocolates.


GERENTE DE LOJA

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar, recrutar e desenvolver a equipe da loja, de acordo com os padrões e diretrizes da companhia, garantindo a formação de times de alta performance alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os resultados de vendas, propondo estratégias comerciais e identificando oportunidades para maximizar o desempenho e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
  • Gerenciar os processos operacionais da loja, assegurando a execução eficiente das rotinas diárias, incluindo vendas, controle de estoque, certificações e reportes, promovendo um ambiente organizado e colaborativo.
  • Atuar como multiplicador do programa global de atendimento, implementando e sustentando boas práticas de gestão e relacionamento com o cliente nas lojas próprias, reforçando os fundamentos aprendidos nos treinamentos.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo (ensino superior completo ou em andamento será considerado um diferencial).
  • Experiência sólida em vendas e atendimento ao cliente, com atuação comprovada em gestão de equipes no varejo.
  • Habilidade em liderar, desenvolver e motivar times, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em resultados, organização e capacidade de tomada de decisão.
  • Excelente comunicação, proatividade e paixão por encantar clientes.
  • Afinidade com o segmento de chocolates ou produtos premium será um diferencial.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer


Highlights

⚡ Work on scalable and innovative applications

Remote flexibility with global teams

Career growth in fast-paced technology environments


Role Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our development team. You will help design, build, and maintain applications that power modern businesses, contributing across the full software lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

• Develop full-stack or back-end solutions with modern frameworks

• Work closely with product managers and designers on requirements

• Write clean, efficient, and testable code

• Participate in code reviews and engineering best practices

• Optimize applications for performance and scalability


Requirements

• Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or Go

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerization (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes)

• Experience with relational and NoSQL databases

• Strong understanding of version control (Git)

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment


Why Join Us

You’ll be working on products that make a real impact in the market. This role offers the chance to solve meaningful problems while advancing your technical expertise.


About Us

We are a global technology company building transformative software solutions. Our culture values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building and deploying ML models in enterprise environments.
  • Proficiency in PySpark , Python, and ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks , Azure ML , AWS SageMaker , or Google Vertex AI .
  • Strong coding skills and experience with scalable data workflows and model deployment.
  • Familiarity with GenAI , LLMs , and NLP techniques.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Availability to support meetings or calls outside standard working hours as needed.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with time-series demand forecasting , margin-aware modeling , text summarization, and stock-based recommendations .
  • Exposure to multi-modal data and personalization strategies across digital ecosystems.


We are seeking a highly capable Data Scientist to help build and scale enterprise-grade AI/ML products within our centralized Data Science team. This role focuses on developing intelligent, production-ready solutions that power personalization, forecasting, and automation across our digital platforms. The ideal candidate is a strong problem-solver, able to work independently, and comfortable supporting collaboration across time zones—including occasional calls outside standard working hours.

title: FBS Sr Finance Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (PST)


What You’ll Do:

You’ll develop the IT annual budget and obtains sign-off by budget owners; prepare IT cost allocations to the business units for IT services and any assigned financial reports; monitor expenditures for assigned services, ensuring compliance with corporate policies; identify ways to automate processes, increasing efficiency and accuracy; review financial implications of new system initiatives and prepares financial analysis reports in support of new projects.


Experience:

  • 5 years of experience.


Skills:

  • Proficiency in English (The interview’ll be in English)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
  • Accounting – Intermediate
  • Forecasting – Intermediate
  • Management Presentation - Entry Level
  • SAP - Intermediate
  • Excel - Advanced


  • Competitive compensation and benefits package:
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus


Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

description:
ESTAGIÁRIO SDR - VOANDO COM GV AGÊNCIA DE VIAGENS


Pré-requisitos:


  • Estar matriculado(a) e frequentando regularmente uma instituição de ensino superior;
  • Morar em Uberlândia ou região;
  • Ser bom/boa comunicador(a);
  • Ter facilidade em conversar por ligação;
  • Ter escrita semântica e ortograficamente correta;
  • Digitar com rapidez.

  • Qualificação: fazer o primeiro contato com leads/cliente via plataforma de mensagens gerando um diagnóstico sobre a qualificação de cada um para o departamento de Vendas;

Benefícios:


  • Bolsa-auxílio de R$ 800,00;
  • Trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar;

  • Treinamentos pessoais e profissionais.

  • Estágio (Lei nº 11.788/2008);
  • Regime de trabalho Home Office;
  • Jornada de trabalho: segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 19h.


✨ É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da equipe da agência mais bem avaliada do Google no Triângulo Mineiro, que tem revolucionado a forma como as pessoas viajam na região e em todo o Brasil!

title: Casino Manager
description:
About the Role:


This role offers an exciting opportunity to take ownership of a new online casino platform from day one. The company is entering a growth phase and is seeking an experienced Platform Manager who can lead the setup, integration, and ongoing operations of their casino environment. Working closely with a third-party platform provider (NuxGame), the selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring the technical, operational, and compliance aspects of the platform are seamlessly managed. This is a hands-on position suited for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and can work independently to drive continuous improvement.


Main Responsibilities:


  • Lead the initial setup, configuration, and deployment of the online casino platform in coordination with NuxGame or a similar platform provider
  • Ensure smooth and stable daily operations of the platform, addressing any issues related to uptime, performance, or user experience
  • Manage and troubleshoot API integrations with payment providers, game studios, and various third-party systems
  • Coordinate closely with the platform provider to implement updates, new features, and performance improvements
  • Monitor platform KPIs and system health to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime
  • Maintain compliance with relevant licensing and regulatory requirements in applicable markets
  • Deliver detailed reports to management regarding platform activity, incidents, updates, and ongoing improvements


Desired Experience:


  • Previous experience launching or managing an online casino platform (experience with NuxGame or similar platforms is highly preferred)
  • Solid understanding of API integrations and confidence in resolving technical issues independently
  • Demonstrated project management ability, especially around platform rollouts and technical updates
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and with external partners
  • Self-motivated and capable of taking ownership of platform operations with minimal supervision
  • Knowledge of licensing and compliance processes in regulated iGaming markets is considered a strong advantage.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Java/Kotlin
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Java 8 (mínimo);

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Kotlin;

Definição de Arquitetura exercendo o papel de Referência Técnica;

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Spring (Boot, Data, Cache, etc);

Conhecimento em Filas (Rabbit);

Experiência em Filas (Kafka);

Experiência em AWS (SNS, SQS, S3);

Experiência em Git e Git-Flow;

Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL;

Desenvolvimento com foco em qualidade: testes unitários e Sonar(métricas);

Experiência em micro serviços e sistemas concorrentes;

Contínuos delivery (Jenkins);


A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

Alguns diferenciais Invillia:

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

_metodologia exclusiva #GlobalGrowthFramework

Faça uma imersão aqui


Então, se você busca uma oportunidade de trabalhar de onde estiver, em uma empresa dedicada em recriar a sensação de proximidade, de conexão humana, e de se sentir acolhido a qualquer momento, mesmo com todos distribuídos, aqui é o lugar certo.

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Java 8 (mínimo);

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Kotlin;

Definição de Arquitetura exercendo o papel de Referência Técnica;

Experiência em desenvolvimento com Spring (Boot, Data, Cache, etc);

Conhecimento em Filas (Rabbit);

Experiência em Filas (Kafka);

Experiência em AWS (SNS, SQS, S3);

Experiência em Git e Git-Flow;

Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL;

Desenvolvimento com foco em qualidade: testes unitários e Sonar(métricas);

Experiência em micro serviços e sistemas concorrentes;

Contínuos delivery (Jenkins);


A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

_metodologia exclusiva #GlobalGrowthFramework

title: Electrical BIM Specialist
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Specialist

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 3-4 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary:  R$10K - R$17K /month


762 Interactive is looking for a Technical Lead to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin- an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy games. We’re searching for someone with strong leadership capabilities, deep technical abilities & a passion for delivering awesome projects. You’ll be the technical backbone of the studio, overseeing architecture, ensuring code quality, and mentoring developers. This role requires both hands-on coding and leadership skills. 


This is a remote position.  


Please do not apply if you have not worked in the games industry.


Responsibilities  

  • Design and develop architectural proposals and guide the vision for engine systems, ensuring they meet desired functionality and performance standards. 
  • Propose tools or technologies that could enhance the ability to delivery great engine systems support. 
  • Own and drive engine topics and subsequent decision making. 
  • Propose and implement solutions to the challenges of performance and scale. 
  • Oversee code reviews, workflows, and best practices. 
  • Identify technical risks and propose solutions. 
  • Stay up-to-date on game dev tools and industry trends. 
  • Collaborate closely with design, art, and production teams to integrate features. 
  • Lead and mentor a team of developers (Unity/C# focus). 
  • Cultivate the team culture in line with the company’s values and goals. 


Requirements  

  • 6+ years of professional game development experience, with 1+ year of leadership/mentorship role. 
  • Strong proficiency with Unity and C#. 
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in one or more engine related focus areas, including but not limited to: rendering, tools, physics, asset/build pipeline..etc. 
  • System architecture skills. 
  • Ability to debug and optimize code. 
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Solid understanding of performance optimization, memory management, and debugging. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English for daily communication with U.S. leadership. 


Nice To Have  

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • Familiarity with analytics, telemetry, or live-ops systems. 


What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits:
  • Health Insurance 
  • Monthly Meal Stipend 
  • Monthly Internet / Home Office Stipend  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Recruiter Senior
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior (RAG Engineer SR)
description:
Estamos contratando: RAG Engineer Sênior - Transformação Digital no Setor Financeiro!


Quer trabalhar na linha de frente da IA aplicada?

Estamos em busca de um(a) RAG Engineer Sênior para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de Recuperação Aumentada por Geração (RAG). O profissional será responsável por projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines que integram grandes modelos de linguagem com sistemas de recuperação de informação em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a arquitetura e implementação de sistemas RAG escaláveis.
  • Desenvolver integrações com LangGraph, MessageBus com Redis e Bedrock (AWS).
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de backend para integrar soluções RAG em aplicações críticas.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes unitários e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Apoiar e mentorar engenheiros juniores no time.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência em Python e FastAPI .
  • Background forte em engenharia de software e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Experiência prática em RAG e deploy em AWS Bedrock, com conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Familiaridade com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e mensageria assíncrona com Redis.
  • Forte background em engenharia de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Importante:

Modalidade de Contratação: PJ (Valor/Hora).

Carga horária: 8h diárias (média de 168h por mês)

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Abono remunerado: 15 dias após 12 meses de contrato (para você recarregar as energias!)

Equipamento: Fornecido pela Sciensa, conforme necessidade da área/projeto.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 17-23k real/mo.


MUST HAVE

3-4 years Back End and 4 years Front End Front end is React

They have to have experience working in Back End and WANT to work in GO

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience software development using JavaScript ES6, HTML5, and CSS3.

Experience with React or React Native, particularly with functional components and hooks.

Experience with statically typed languages such as Go, C, C++, or Rust.

Solid understanding of server-side rendering (SSR), asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and RESTful APIs.

Proficiency in Redux, TypeScript, and NoSQL databases.

Commitment to high-quality coding practices, including comprehensive documentation, active participation in code reviews, and adherence to best practices in software development.

Passion for staying current with the latest software tools and methodologies.

Intellectual curiosity and strong problem-solving skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


PLUS:

Golang experience


D2D:

This specific project is focusing on the enhancements and new features of the Total Wine Website. This specific team works on rewards system and preference center (account information, opt in, etc.)

They have some work planned out in integrating promotion engineering

Doing maintenance work with core team. Updating versions of Node, Go and secruoty vulnerability work. Might pick up backlog of cart and checkout team as well

collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, backend engineers, test automation engineers, UX designers, and Scrum Masters to continuously enhance customer experience.

Develop and maintain modular frontend web and mobile applications, ensuring high performance, maintainability, and testability.

Participate in the development and updating of shared component libraries to enable rapid iteration and consistent development practices.

Mentor and coach mid-level and junior developers, fostering a sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.

Cultivate a positive team atmosphere that encourages open communication, creative problem-solving, and innovative thinking.

Translate functional requirements into responsive components and pages with a mobile-first mentality, championing accessibility best practices.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, ensuring the stability and reliability of applications.

Contribute to code reviews and automated testing efforts, ensuring code quality and meeting coverage targets.

Participate in an on-call rotation with the entire digital and engineering organizations, including Directors and members of the Product team.

title: Recruitment Consultant
description:
Company Overview: AMX Healthcare is a leading national workforce solutions provider committed to connecting talented healthcare professionals with exceptional career opportunities. We're driven by innovation, technology, and a supportive, dynamic culture that fosters personal and professional growth.


Role Summary: The Recruiter will be responsible for conducting high-volume candidate outreach via telephone, screening healthcare professionals for both temporary and permanent assignments, effectively selling job opportunities, retrieving essential compliance documentation, and accurately updating our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable with high call volumes, and excel at building lasting relationships with healthcare professionals.


High-Volume Candidate Outreach:

  • Conduct 100+ outbound calls per day to prospective healthcare candidates.
  • Screen and qualify candidates effectively, matching their skills and interests to available job opportunities.
  • Clearly communicate job descriptions, assignment details, and benefits to candidates to generate interest.


Relationship Building & Candidate Management:

  • Establish strong relationships with candidates through consistent and professional communication.
  • Proactively follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to maintain engagement and commitment.
  • Actively manage and nurture candidate pipelines for future opportunities.


Compliance & Documentation:

  • Obtain and verify job-specific compliance documents, including licenses, credentials, and background check information.
  • Ensure candidates meet all compliance requirements prior to placement.
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate compliance documentation within the ATS.


Applicant Tracking System (ATS) Management:

  • Accurately enter and update candidate details, communications, and compliance information within the ATS.
  • Regularly audit ATS records to ensure completeness and accuracy.


Performance & Target Achievement:

  • Consistently meet or exceed daily and weekly activity targets for calls, screenings, candidate submissions, and compliance completion.
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and suggest process improvements to enhance productivity and effectiveness.


Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in recruitment, high-volume candidate sourcing, telemarketing, or related roles.
  • Excellent telephone communication skills and confidence handling high call volumes daily.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and compliance processes in healthcare recruitment.


Skills & Attributes:

  • Results-driven, motivated, and capable of working independently and collaboratively.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills for engaging with candidates and colleagues.
  • Detail-oriented with strong administrative skills, ensuring accuracy in documentation and data entry.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable managing a fast-paced recruitment pipeline.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an extremely attractive commission scheme.
  • Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
  • An energetic, supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth within AMX Healthcare.
  • All paid trips abroad for top performers

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About the role

As a Technical Account Manager, you will play a key role in delivering strategic services and support to Riskifield's client ensuring their success and maximizing the value of our solutions

Riskifield's clients come in many shapes and sizes, span multiple software platforms and each one has its own unique story and internal flows. The Technical Account Manager will be working cross-functionally to assist our merchants in scaling up the technical aspects of our products.

Externally, you’ll be working with brand-name retailers who are looking to reduce online fraud rates, and increase their bottom line by optimizing, improving, and enhancing their current Riskified services.

Internally, you'll collaborate daily with various departments including Product, Account Management, Analytics, Data Science, and Development to ensure all relevant aspects of the product life cycle are addressed, being one of the primary points of contact of the Integrations team.

The end goal of the Technical Account Manager is to own the technical aspects of integration efforts, upsells and cross-sales to accelerate our merchants’ growth.


What You'll Be Doing

Serve as the main technical focal point for Riskified’s enterprise merchants, leading upsells, cross-sales and other efforts

Analyze clients’ requirements and business needs from technical and functional perspectives and fit solutions by having a deep understanding of our system and products’ capabilities

Build, monitor, and execute joint project plans with clients

Work closely with Account Management, Sales and Support teams as a technical subject matter expert and offer technical support for new and existing products and services

Proactively Initiate and design process improvements, tools, features, and product enhancements.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English proficiency is required to effectively communicate in a professional environment
  • At least 4 years of experience as a technical account manager/ integrations engineer/ solution engineer / technical project manager working with multiple enterprise customers’ technical and business teams
  • Client-facing: excellent communication and project management skills, working with various stakeholders (PMs, and technical resources)
  • Proven technical background, experience with troubleshooting client issues, reading logs, querying DBs, reviewing code, and offering solutions
  • Experience working with databases and querying languages (e.g. SQL)
  • Excel in critical thinking and technical troubleshooting of multi layered, complex problem statements while maintaining excellent internal and external stakeholder relationships
  • Proven technical background with API integrations; should be comfortable reading logs and source code
  • Prior experience working with internal interfaces such as Development, Product, Account Management, Sales teams in a global organization
  • Enthusiastic problem solver with a proactive approach
  • Superb English writing and communication skills
  • Prior B2B SaaS/PaaS/IaaS experience
  • Experience working with e-commerce and/or payments industry - advantage
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and Magento - an advantage


3 Key areas to focus


Technical Expertise & Troubleshooting:

  • Highlight your proficiency with API integrations
  • SQL
  • log analysis
  • troubleshooting complex technical issues
  • discuss how you've analyzed client requirements and resolved multi-layered challenges in past roles


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management:

  • Emphasize your experience working with diverse teams—including Product, Account Management, and Development—to build and execute joint project plans
  • drive process improvements
  • ensure smooth integration efforts


Client Engagement & Business Acumen:

  • Demonstrate your strong client-facing skills and your ability to translate technical solutions into tangible business value
  • Discuss how you've supported upsells, cross-sales, and enhanced client services to reduce online fraud and boost overall performance

title: AI Consultant
description:
Title: AI Consultant

Location: 100% remote

Job Type: Contract

Description:

Serve as a trusted technical advisor, assessing customer needs to define optimal AI architectures. Lead strategic engagements and manage the deployment of cloud AI solutions using Google’s best practices. Architect and implement multi-step Agentic AI workflows using ADK, Agent Engine, LangChain, Vertex AI, and AgentSpace . Guide customers on the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation in BigQuery, model validation, and establishing MLOps best practices for scalable operations on Google Cloud.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Descrição da Empresa : A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.




Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Editor de Reels que esteja disposto a aprender mais. Este papel é focado na criação, edição e produção de conteúdo de vídeo para diversos projetos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem editar vídeos, fazer correção de cor, criar gráficos em movimento e colaborar com a equipe para garantir que os projetos atendam aos padrões esperados. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações

  • Produção e Edição de Vídeo: Necessário possuir experiência em edição de vídeo.
  • Além das habilidades acima, serão considerados diferenciais a familiaridade com softwares adicionais de design e edição e experiência comprovada em projetos de vídeo em diversos setores.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pleno - Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Analista irá atuar em desenvolvimento de sistemas com a linguagem ADVPL.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar com desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, codificação em front-end e back-end;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs Rest em linguagem ADVPL para integração com sistemas parceiros;
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas complexas, com nível de supervisão moderado e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Compreender a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Superior Completo na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em programação ADVPL;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em programação SQL;
  • Desejável conhecimento em processo de negócios backoffice;
  • Vivencia em ambientes que utilizem metodologia Ágil.
  • Banco de Dados – nível intermediário;


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Software Engineer Sênior Golang
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?


A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
About MeetGeek

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that doesn't just listen, it acts. We help teams automate meeting capture, summarization, and now, with agentic AI workflows, MeetGeek becomes an active participant in meetings, surfacing data, triggering automations, and even taking actions on your behalf.

From Zoom to Teams to Google Meet, MeetGeek integrates with 5,000+ tools like HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, and more — helping revenue, product, and operations teams turn conversations into structured workflows.

Thousands of companies in 100+ countries already trust us. Backed by top-tier investors and led by a team of AI, NLP, and systems engineering veterans, MeetGeek is redefining what meetings can do.

It's a great time to join MeetGeek. We’re a quickly growing remote team, well-funded, and helping thousands of teams improve their meetings.


About MeetGeek

We’re looking for a Customer Success Representative (Junior) who’s passionate about helping customers succeed — and curious about what’s next in AI, automation, and workflow design.

This role blends customer support, customer success, and operations . You’ll help users go beyond meeting notes and unlock the full power of MeetGeek’s agentic capabilities — from automated follow-ups to real-time action triggers.


About the Role

Technical Troubleshooting

Support users through questions about agent setup, integrations, or system behavior. Collaborate with engineering to resolve edge cases.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Instrutor de Inglês


Requisitos para as vagas:


Fluência no idioma inglês;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar de seg a quinta.

Internet com boa velocidade;

Possibilidade de trabalhar de casa.

Ser maior de idade


Diferenciais:


Já ter experiência com aulas de inglês;

Disponibilidade para trabalho durante a noite;


Atividades:

Instruir aulas de inglês à distância;

Apresentar relatório de aulas dadas para pagamento;


Remuneração:

Remuneração depende da disponibilidade do instrutor para as aulas, podendo chegar a uma média de R$2200,00.


Local de Trabalho: Própria Casa.


Benefícios:

Prestação de serviço, você escolhe os horários que deseja disponibilizar, ambiente agradável e podendo exercer a função do conforto de sua casa, sexta é mais tranquila, pois normalmente não tem aulas.

title: Android Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a skilled Android Engineer to lead the development of innovative mobile applications with a focus on cross-platform initiatives using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Jetpack Compose. Experience with iOS development is a strong plus, as you’ll help shape our cross-platform architecture and deliver products that seamlessly operate across Android and iOS ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, develop, and maintain mobile applications leveraging KMP for shared business logic and Compose for modern UI design.
  • Collaborate on cross-platform initiatives, contributing to both Android and iOS codebases when necessary.
  • Analyze and optimize high-volume mobile systems for performance and scalability.
  • Refactor and revitalize codebases as technology evolves.
  • Lead development efforts for new products and enhancements to existing products in response to market changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system failures, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
  • Work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative features.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in Android development with proficiency in Kotlin
  • Android Launcher experience is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Exposure to or experience with iOS development (Swift or Objective-C) is a strong plus.
  • Strong architecture design skills and ability to build reusable UI components.
  • Comfortable working on collaborative, fast-paced engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial drive and passion for innovation.

title: Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)
description:
Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)

We are looking for a talented software developer with strong mobile app development experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modern tech stacks, integrating AI into their workflow, and solving complex system-level problems that drive our product forward.

Must-Have Skills
  • Mobile app development experience (iOS preferred, Swift expertise required).
  • Familiarity with CICD pipelines and Git workflows.
  • Strong coding skills in at least two of the following:
  • Python
  • TypeScript
  • Swift
  • Experience building and integrating with REST or gRPC APIs.
  • Ability to solve complex system problems and contribute to key architectural decisions .
  • Strong sense of ownership over your work and outcomes.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Comfortable experimenting with and integrating AI tools in development workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot).
  • Exposure to ML/AI engineering concepts , with strong interest in LLMs, embeddings, and agent-based systems .
  • Background in game design or interactive UX development.
  • Experience with Java or Android development (not required, but a plus).
What We’re Looking For
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment.
  • A developer who doesn’t just write code, but looks for smarter, more efficient ways to ship great products.
  • A team player with a growth mindset, positive attitude, and passion for building high-impact software.

title: Backend Ops & Integrations Assistant
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

We’re seeking experienced, detail-oriented backend ops & integrations assistants to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog, but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re an effective problem-solver who’s always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re great at time management.
  • You’re a team player.
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DnD, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of professional experience in backend web development
  • Proficiency in WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, and Shopify
  • Strong PHP skills
  • Impressive portfolio
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking)
  • A bachelor’s degree (a plus)
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript
  • Expertise in responsive design and mobile-first approach
  • Able to optimize applications for maximum speed
  • Knowledge of HTML layout for the construction of email signatures and newsletters


About the Role


Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting backend work on Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify
  • Managing integrations across HubSpot, Teamwork, Google Workspace, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress
  • Handling CMS updates, plugins, and troubleshooting
  • Configuring workflows and light automation (Zapier/Make)
  • Launching websites on Webflow, WordPress, or Shopify, including domain setup, DNS/SSL, CMS updates, and go-live QA


Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!
